base_revision.description: song.state revision the ops were built against; if the file changed since, ops are re-applied when every 'expect' still holds (rebased) else edit_conflict.
base_revision.title: Base Revision

ops.description: Edit operations applied atomically, in order. Primitive: {op:set,path,value,expect?} {op:unset,path} {op:insert,path,index?,value} {op:remove,path,expect?} {op:move,path,to}. Semantic: {op:hit,track,lane,bar,step,velocity|null} {op:add_hits,track,hits:[{beat,lane,velocity?,sample?}],quantize?} {op:split_clip,track,clip,at_beat} {op:duplicate_clip,track,clip,at_bar?} {op:add_point,target,bar,value,curve?} {op:revert_to,version}. Paths are id-based like versions.diff: tracks.drums.pattern.lanes.kick.overrides.7, tracks.sample.clips[0].instances.3.mute (indices 0-based).
ops.title: Ops
